la_links_school.name: Louisiana School Immunization Dashboard (LINKS)
la_links_school.location: LDH Tableau Server - School Immunization Dashboard
la_links_school.description: Parish-level school immunization compliance data for Louisiana kindergarteners, collected annually through Louisiana's school immunization reporting requirements. Data are derived from the LINKS (Louisiana Immunization Network for Kids Statewide) immunization registry. The dashboard at analytics.la.gov provides parish-by-parish vaccination coverage rates for required vaccines. Data are accessed via the Tableau Server CSV export endpoint, which requires establishing a session cookie via an initial page load.
la_links_school.restrictions: Public domain. Louisiana Department of Health public data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
